definitions: A piece of furniture with a flat top and one or more legs, providing a level surface for eating, writing, or working.
A set of facts or figures systematically displayed, especially in columns.
A flat, horizontal surface or a raised area.
In some sports, the playing surface itself.
examples: We sat around the table for dinner.
The surgeon prepared the patient on the operating table.
The snooker table was recently re-covered.
